hooks.command: if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'APIMyResume plugin: Bun is not installed, so its resume tools are unavailable. Install it with `npm install -g bun` (or `curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash`), then run /mcp to reconnect the apimyresume server.'; elif [ ! -d "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/node_modules/@myriaddreamin" ]; then (cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && bun install --production --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1) && echo 'APIMyResume plugin: installed the PDF renderer. If its tools are missing, run /mcp to reconnect the apimyresume server.'; fi
